title: EXP-M6-SLM research results store record
description: One appended run record in the digest-chained, append-only research results store. Separate from production logs. Metric names follow EVALUATION-PROTOCOL.md (eval-protocol-v1.0.0): VMSR, VSMS/$, VSMS/W, FNER, AVR, frontier calls avoided, UER, operator-active minutes, latency, schema-invalid output rate, ECE, Brier, throughput.

model_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact model artifact (incl. quantization variant).

benchmark_hash.description: Hash of the frozen benchmark manifest (Control Bench v0 or later version).

seed.description: Seed drawn from the frozen seed list, in order.

seed_index.description: Index into the frozen seed list (recorded per run per protocol section 7).

hardware.description: Exact SKU/class, memory, driver/runtime versions, node count, thermal/power-capping state.

inference_config.description: Runtime+version, prompt/template digest, decoding params, context length, batch size.

metrics.description: Frozen metric names only; values are numbers. Safety metrics (fner, avr) are reported standalone and never composited.

raw_outputs.description: Raw per-item outputs (or content-addressed references to them) needed for replay/audit without secret material.

exclusions.description: Preregistered exclusions only (protocol section 8), each with reason and affected item_ids/contamination_groups.
